deadline.value: January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027; all materials incl. letters and official scores by that date
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall 2027 admission is January 15, 2027.

app_fee.quote: The fee is US$70 for domestic applicants and US$90 for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: No international fee-waiver route stated on the department pages checked

gre_general.quote: Both the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Tests (Verbal, Quantitative, and Analytical) and the GRE Physics Subject Test are optional this year.

gre_physics.quote: GRE General Tests (optional); Physics GRE Subject Test (optional)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo accepted (TOEFL code 1836); minimum not shown on the pages checked
toefl_min.quote: The institution code for TOEFL is 1836.

english_waiver.value: Exemption only for degrees/study in the U.S. or an approved English-primary country; India is not on the Graduate College's approved list
english_waiver.quote: Received a post-secondary degree from a U.S. institution (or an institution within an approved country) within five years of the proposed admission term. | Illinois Graduate Admissions recognizes the following countries as having English as the primary language: Australia, Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, Canada, ...

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the department committee; no pre-application supervisor requirement mentioned on the pages checked

funding.value: Most admitted students are offered a Teaching Assistantship
funding.quote: Most students to whom we offer admission are also offered a Teaching Assistantship for financial support.

entry_route.value: Final-year bachelor's applicants are considered (overall and advanced-physics GPA)
entry_route.quote: For applicants who are currently in the final year of a bachelor's degree program, the department's graduate admissions committee will consider both the overall GPA and the GPA computed for intermediate and advanced physics courses.

notes: Three letters of reference. Incomplete applications after January 15 are not considered.
